title: massage — muscle

phrases.translation: n. 按摩院；（挂按摩院招牌的）妓院

sentences.sentence: Massage helps ease the pain.
sentences.translation: 按摩有助于缓解疼痛。

sentences.sentence: Why don’t you have a massage ?
sentences.translation: 你为什么不按摩一下？

sentences.sentence: Joan gave me a gentle neck massage .
sentences.translation: 琼轻轻地给我做了个颈部按摩。

sentences.sentence: For all her experience as a television reporter, she was still prone to camera nerves.
sentences.translation: 尽管有丰富的做电视记者的经验，她仍然倾向于在镜头前紧张。

sentences.sentence: He’s a very picky eater .
sentences.translation: 他很挑食。

sentences.sentence: When I finally found my bearings, I was standing on Congress avenue, out of breath, smeared up and down with grass stains and dog shit.
sentences.translation: 当我终于能确定方向时，我发现自己在国会大街上，上气不接下气，草渍和狗屎全身都是。

sentences.sentence: He exerted preterhuman self-denial in abstaining from finishing him completely; but getting out of breath he finally desisted, and dragged the apparently inanimate body on to the settle.
sentences.translation: 他使出超人的自制力克制自己，才没有送他的命，可是他终于喘不过气来，罢手了，又把那显然已无生气的身体拖到高背椅子旁边。

sentences.sentence: the four main acupuncture points
sentences.translation: 四大穴位

sentences.sentence: (It's worth noting that while Bhutto was generally well-liked in India, she was seen there as an ineffective and weak politician).
sentences.translation: （值得注意的是，虽然贝布托在印度受到爱戴，但她还是被认为是一个低效的孱弱的政治家）。

sentences.sentence: She lay sleepless for hours, worrying.
sentences.translation: 她忧心忡忡地躺了几个小时都无法入睡。

sentences.sentence: I don’t know how you can be so laid-back about your exams.
sentences.translation: 我不明白你对考试怎么会如此不在乎。

sentences.sentence: “The bottom line question to ask is, Is your forgetfulness fundamentally interfering with how you function?
sentences.translation: "要问的底线问题是,你的健忘是否真的根本性地妨碍了你的行动?"

sentences.sentence: Health experts say that stress can come with some pretty surprising symptoms—from forgetfulness to nausea to skin rashes.
sentences.translation: 健康专家们认为压力会伴随着许多令人惊讶的征兆而来——从健忘到恶心，甚至是皮疹。

sentences.sentence: “Most people when they turn 50 begin to look at forgetfulness with more seriousness, ” said Dr. Gene Cohen, the director of the Center for Aging, Health and Humanities at George Washington University.
sentences.translation: "大多数人们步入50岁后便开始严肃地看待健忘这个问题了,"乔治华盛顿大学人类老化,健康及人类研究中心的吉恩柯翰博士说.

sentences.sentence: Overall they experienced the same stress-reducing effects of the brisk walkers. Better yet, the effects were evident immediately.
sentences.translation: 总的来说他们与轻快步行的那组压力减轻的程度是相同的，但前者的见效更快。

sentences.sentence: People who are new to wellness usually are introduced to one part of this triangle such as exercise, diet or stress-reducing practices (meditation).
sentences.translation: 刚刚接受健康教育的人们通常是先接触“健康三角”的一个方面，比如：锻炼身体，调节饮食，或者练习减压（默想）。

sentences.sentence: Realise you need to be systematic to make it work or you just escalate your disorganisation.
sentences.translation: 必须有系统条理性地让工作进行，不然你只是在加剧工作的混乱度。

sentences.sentence: I think he’s being unreasonable.
sentences.translation: 我认为他是在无理取闹。

sentences.sentence: Don’t let your boss make unreasonable demands on you.
sentences.translation: 别让你的老板对你提无理的要求。

sentences.sentence: A 50% market share is achievable.
sentences.translation: 百分之五十的市场占有率是可实现的。

sentences.sentence: It is often a good idea to start with smaller, easily achievable goals.
sentences.translation: 以较小的、容易实现的目标来做开端经常是个好主意。

phrases.translation: 信用制度；信贷制度；赊购或赊销制度
信用风险；信贷风险；信用危机
信贷紧缩；信贷危机（等于credit crisis）
n. 消费信贷；消费品信用贷款
n. 农村信用合作社，农村信用社
信用信息；信用情报；信用调查报告

sentences.sentence: Credit must go to Fiona for making sure everything ran smoothly.
sentences.translation: 应该感激菲奥娜使一切得以顺利进行。

sentences.sentence: I do yoga twice a week.
sentences.translation: 我一周做两次瑜伽。

sentences.sentence: Drugs helped to relieve the pain.
sentences.translation: 药物有助于舒缓疼痛。

sentences.sentence: Relax your stomach muscles , then stretch again.
sentences.translation: 放松腹部肌肉，然后再绷紧。

sentences.sentence: Regular exercise will help to strengthen your muscles .
sentences.translation: 经常锻炼有助于强健肌肉。

sentences.sentence: Rooney has pulled a muscle in his thigh and won’t play tomorrow.
sentences.translation: 鲁尼大腿肌肉拉伤，明天不能参赛了。

text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 136 单元

massage
音标：英 /'mæsɑːʒ; mə'sɑːʒ; -dʒ/  美 /mə'sɑʒ/
n& vi. 按摩
短语：foot massage — 足部按摩；脚底按摩
短语：massage chair — 按摩椅
短语：massage oil — 按摩油
短语：therapeutic massage — 保健按摩
短语：massage parlor — n. 按摩院；（挂按摩院招牌的）妓院
例句：Massage helps ease the pain.
按摩有助于缓解疼痛。
例句：Why don’t you have a massage ?
你为什么不按摩一下？
例句：Joan gave me a gentle neck massage .
琼轻轻地给我做了个颈部按摩。

prone
音标：英 /prəʊn/  美 /pron/
adj. 易于发生（不愉快事）的
短语：prone position — 卧姿；伏卧位
例句：For all her experience as a television reporter, she was still prone to camera nerves.
尽管有丰富的做电视记者的经验，她仍然倾向于在镜头前紧张。

picky
音标：英 /'pɪkɪ/  美 /'pɪki/
adj. 好挑剔的
例句：He’s a very picky eater .
他很挑食。

out of breath
上气不接下气的
例句：When I finally found my bearings, I was standing on Congress avenue, out of breath, smeared up and down with grass stains and dog shit.
当我终于能确定方向时，我发现自己在国会大街上，上气不接下气，草渍和狗屎全身都是。
例句：He exerted preterhuman self-denial in abstaining from finishing him completely; but getting out of breath he finally desisted, and dragged the apparently inanimate body on to the settle.
他使出超人的自制力克制自己，才没有送他的命，可是他终于喘不过气来，罢手了，又把那显然已无生气的身体拖到高背椅子旁边。

stress sb. out
使某人紧张、焦虑

lose one's appetite
没有食欲

acupuncture
音标：英 /'ækjʊ,pʌŋ(k)tʃə/  美 /'ækjupʌŋktʃɚ/
n. 针灸
短语：acupuncture and moxibustion — 针灸；针灸疗法；针灸科
短语：acupuncture point — 穴位，穴道
短语：acupuncture needle — n. 针灸针
例句：the four main acupuncture points
四大穴位

well-liked
adj. 漂亮的
例句：(It's worth noting that while Bhutto was generally well-liked in India, she was seen there as an ineffective and weak politician).
（值得注意的是，虽然贝布托在印度受到爱戴，但她还是被认为是一个低效的孱弱的政治家）。

sleepless
音标：英 /'sliːplɪs/  美 /'slipləs/
adj. 失眠的
短语：sleepless night — 不眠之夜
例句：She lay sleepless for hours, worrying.
她忧心忡忡地躺了几个小时都无法入睡。

laid-back
音标：英 /'leidbæk/  美 /'leidbæk/
adj. 自在的，从容的
例句：I don’t know how you can be so laid-back about your exams.
我不明白你对考试怎么会如此不在乎。

forgetfulness
n. 健忘
例句：“The bottom line question to ask is, Is your forgetfulness fundamentally interfering with how you function?
"要问的底线问题是,你的健忘是否真的根本性地妨碍了你的行动?"
例句：Health experts say that stress can come with some pretty surprising symptoms—from forgetfulness to nausea to skin rashes.
健康专家们认为压力会伴随着许多令人惊讶的征兆而来——从健忘到恶心，甚至是皮疹。
例句：“Most people when they turn 50 begin to look at forgetfulness with more seriousness, ” said Dr. Gene Cohen, the director of the Center for Aging, Health and Humanities at George Washington University.
"大多数人们步入50岁后便开始严肃地看待健忘这个问题了,"乔治华盛顿大学人类老化,健康及人类研究中心的吉恩柯翰博士说.

stress-reducing
adj. 减轻压力的
例句：Overall they experienced the same stress-reducing effects of the brisk walkers. Better yet, the effects were evident immediately.
总的来说他们与轻快步行的那组压力减轻的程度是相同的，但前者的见效更快。
例句：People who are new to wellness usually are introduced to one part of this triangle such as exercise, diet or stress-reducing practices (meditation).
刚刚接受健康教育的人们通常是先接触“健康三角”的一个方面，比如：锻炼身体，调节饮食，或者练习减压（默想）。

energise
音标：英 /'enədʒaɪz/  美 /'enədʒaiz/
vt. 激励，激发

disorganisation
n. 计划不周，混乱
例句：Realise you need to be systematic to make it work or you just escalate your disorganisation.
必须有系统条理性地让工作进行，不然你只是在加剧工作的混乱度。

unreasonable
音标：英 /ʌn'riːz(ə)nəb(ə)l/  美 /ʌn'riznəbl/
adj. 不合理的，不讲道理的
例句：I think he’s being unreasonable.
我认为他是在无理取闹。
例句：Don’t let your boss make unreasonable demands on you.
别让你的老板对你提无理的要求。

achievable
音标：英 /ə'tʃi:vəbəl/  美 /ə'tʃivəbl/
adj. 可完成的，可有成就的
例句：A 50% market share is achievable.
百分之五十的市场占有率是可实现的。
例句：It is often a good idea to start with smaller, easily achievable goals.
以较小的、容易实现的目标来做开端经常是个好主意。

credit
音标：英 /'kredɪt/  美 /'krɛdɪt/
n. 赞扬，荣誉，功劳
短语：credit card — 信用卡；记帐卡
短语：letter of credit — n. [商]（银行发行的）信用证
短语：credit system — 信用制度；信贷制度；赊购或赊销制度
短语：credit risk — 信用风险；信贷风险；信用危机
短语：on credit — 赊帐
短语：credit first — 信用第一
短语：credit rating — 信用等级；信誉评价
短语：credit management — 信贷管理；信用调节
短语：bank credit — 银行信贷；银行信用状
短语：credit standing — 信用状况；商业信誉
短语：credit crisis — 信用危机
短语：credit crunch — 信贷紧缩；信贷危机（等于credit crisis）
短语：credit market — 信贷市场；信用市场
短语：consumer credit — n. 消费信贷；消费品信用贷款
短语：social credit — 社会信贷说
短语：credit guarantee — 信用担保；信贷保证
短语：irrevocable letter of credit — 不可撤销信用证
短语：rural credit cooperatives — n. 农村信用合作社，农村信用社
短语：credit information — 信用信息；信用情报；信用调查报告
短语：letters of credit — 信用证；信用状
例句：Credit must go to Fiona for making sure everything ran smoothly.
应该感激菲奥娜使一切得以顺利进行。

yoga
音标：英 /'jəʊgə/  美 /'joɡə/
n. 瑜伽，瑜伽术
例句：I do yoga twice a week.
我一周做两次瑜伽。

relieve
音标：英 /rɪ'liːv/  美 /rɪ'liv/
vt. 减轻，解除
短语：relieve oneself — v. 大小便
短语：relieve stress — 减压，缓解压力
短语：relieve from — 从…中解除，减轻
短语：relieve of — 解除；消除；减轻…之…
例句：Drugs helped to relieve the pain.
药物有助于舒缓疼痛。

muscle
音标：英 /'mʌs(ə)l/  美 /'mʌsl/
n. 肌肉
短语：smooth muscle — 平滑肌
短语：skeletal muscle — n. 骨骼肌；骨肌
短语：muscle strength — 肌肉强度
短语：cardiac muscle — n. [解]心肌
短语：muscle cell — 肌细胞
短语：heart muscle — 心肌
短语：muscle contraction — 肌肉收缩；肌收缩
短语：muscle tissue — 肌肉组织；肌组织
短语：muscle fiber — 肌纤维，肌肉纤维
短语：muscle fatigue — 肌肉疲劳；肌肉疲惫
短语：muscle tone — 肌张力；肌肉紧张度
短语：on the muscle — [美国俚语]
短语：muscle strain — 肌肉拉伤；肌肉劳损
短语：muscle spasm — 肌肉痉挛
短语：abdominal muscle — 腹肌
短语：muscle protein — 肌蛋白，肌肉蛋白
短语：papillary muscle — 乳头状肌
短语：pectoral muscle — 胸肌
短语：adductor muscle — 收肌；肉柱；内收肌
短语：muscle spindle — n. 肌梭；肌纺锤
例句：Relax your stomach muscles , then stretch again.
放松腹部肌肉，然后再绷紧。
例句：Regular exercise will help to strengthen your muscles .
经常锻炼有助于强健肌肉。
例句：Rooney has pulled a muscle in his thigh and won’t play tomorrow.
鲁尼大腿肌肉拉伤，明天不能参赛了。
